objectives.title: Resolve a library to its Context7 id
objectives.why: Resolving first is what stops you fetching docs for the wrong package.

objectives.title: Fetch version-accurate docs
objectives.why: Model training data goes stale; Context7 pulls the docs for the version you actually use.

objectives.title: Narrow a lookup to a topic
objectives.why: Pulling a whole library's docs burns context; a topic-scoped fetch is the difference between usable and overwhelming.

objectives.title: Look up several of your dependencies
objectives.why: One library is a trial; your whole stack is a habit.

objectives.title: Tell your agent to check docs first
objectives.why: A rule in CLAUDE.md is what makes this happen without you asking every time.

objectives.title: Check the server into the project
objectives.why: In .mcp.json it works for your teammates too, not just on your laptop.

bestPractices.title: Keep your Context7 API key out of git
bestPractices.why: A committed key is someone else's quota.

bestPractices.title: Fetch docs before writing against an unfamiliar API
bestPractices.why: Hallucinated method names are exactly what up-to-date docs prevent.

criteria.rubric: Do the project rules instruct the agent to look up current documentation before writing code against an unfamiliar library?

badges.name: Rule Setter
badges.description: Told your agent to check docs first.

badges.name: Shared
badges.description: Checked the server into the project.

badges.name: Keeper
badges.description: Keeps the API key out of git.

badges.name: Informed
badges.description: Docs-first is written into the rules.
